svg.title: Find the antiderivative coefficient by reversing the chain rule
svg.desc: To integrate two x plus three cubed, increase the outer power to four and try K times two x plus three to the fourth power plus C. Differentiation gives K times four times two x plus three cubed times two, or eight K times the original integrand. Set eight K equal to one, so K is one eighth. The antiderivative is two x plus three to the fourth power divided by eight, plus C. The inner derivative two must be included.
